problem: The HB32 carrier self-heal repairs an absent WorkerCoordinator but treats any live worker PID as reusable even when its task-capable cycle is stale. A wedged live PID can therefore leave resident requests REQUESTED indefinitely despite the existing oscillator carrier and controlled restart machinery.
planned_mutation: reuse the existing runtime-presence freshness predicate before accepting an alive WorkerCoordinator
reuse the existing controlled process termination helper when an alive worker is stale/non-task-capable
restart only the existing WorkerCoordinator runner and require a fresh task-capable tick
preserve HB32 oscillator-only cadence and all authority boundaries

readme_impact.reason: This changes resident failure-recovery behavior: an alive-but-stale WorkerCoordinator will be recycled rather than treated as healthy.
